programme.desc: Get ready for a competitive day with the Oddbods! When Newt is laughed out of the boys' go-karting activities, she resolves to teach them a lesson and prove she's more than a match for them in a race. Then, Jeff isn't the most athletic, and when he gets roped into a sports game against some overly competitive Greybods, he finds he's out of his depth. Plus, Pogo discovers a remote control that can pause and rewind real life!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are getting into some big trouble! First, Bubbles accidentally activates her age-reversing machine, affecting the entire cul-de-sac. All the Oddbods are turned into Babybods, and it's up to Fuse to 'Nanny-up' and keep his temper in check! Then, Newt falls for a wild gopher and tries to adopt it, but it would rather eat Jeff's prizewinning flowers. Finally, Slick is teleported inside an old arcade machine and Bubbles must rescue him!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some new problems! Zee is zapped by an impatient Bubbles who is tired of his sluggishness. He soon finds himself sped up, but with some unintended side effects! Then, Fuse discovers his long-lost teddy bear, Mr. Snuffles, but as soon as he is found, he is lost again! Fuse goes to extreme lengths to find his bear. Finally, Fuse accidentally breaks Bubbles' totem pole and tries to cover it up.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are getting into some magical situations! Pogo is bored, so when he discovers a genie in a magic lamp who grants three wishes, he uses them to try and get his friends in the mood for fun. Then, Jeff wants to impress his friends with his hors d'oeuvres, but he is upstaged by Zee, who has a secret ingredient. Finally, Zee accidentally gets on Bubbles' rescue mission to stop a meteor storm and his surprising talent may be just what she needs!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange day for the Oddbods! Newt, Jeff and Pogo all go out for the perfect picnic, except each has a separate idea of what that entails! Then, a rogue bear enters Oddsville and the park ranger's tranquilizer darts accidentally hit Zee! It's up to the Oddbods to watch over his sleepwalking antics. Finally, after a moment of humiliation, Pogo and Jeff get into a competitive battle to see who the better clown is.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange day for the Oddbods! Ashamed by another angry outburst, Fuse decides to reinvent himself as a brand new, calmer Oddbod. How will the others take to this new character? Then, Bubbles is in full detective mode when things are stolen from the Oddbods while they sleep. But will she like what she finds? The trouble continues when Jeff's meddling accidentally turns Bubbles back into a baby-bod!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a very busy day! Zee needs some money, so he does some odd jobs, but his laziness makes him a less-than-ideal employee. Then, after a near-accident, Bubbles creates a health serum to improve a cow's intelligence, but a guinea pig eats it instead and develops a super-brain! Finally, it's photo day, and Slick is determined to make sure he's front and center in the picture this year.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are on the move! When modifications to Fuse's truck cause it to develop a mind of its own and turn truly monstrous, he must take back control to protect his friends. Then, Pogo loses his license after a bout of reckless driving and is horrified to discover that he's got Jeff as his examiner! Plus, when Newt is upstaged by Pogo, she grows determined to become strong herself with some help from Fuse.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Bubbles is having an out-of-this-world day! An eclipse is forecast, and when her friends mysteriously start to disappear, Bubbles believes aliens are behind the abductions! Her belief in aliens continues as she tries to provide proof of their existence, but her overzealous approach annoys her neighbors. The space-themed fun continues when Pogo gets his hands on Bubbles' prototype jetpack and gets stranded in the upper atmosphere!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods have some new goals! After a sequence of annoying events, Jeff decides he's had enough and is moving out! The others rally together to convince him to stay. Then, Fuse and Slick are smitten with a female jogger who blows them both a kiss. The pair are determined to outshine one another to prove who the kiss was for. Finally, Zee enters a road endurance race to win a trophy that looks like a gigantic hot dog!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Things are getting wild for the Oddbods! First, Bubbles is transformed into a bee-sized creature after an accident with one of her experiments. While facing the dangers of the world, she must get Newt's help to turn back to her normal self. Then, an incident with Fuse sends Jeff off the deep end, and he quickly descends into a feral state! Fuse and Newt must work together to rehabilitate their friend back to normality.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange day for the Oddbods! When Zee is caught 'borrowing' electricity from Jeff, Jeff makes him clean up his messy house as payment. Then, Slick and Pogo get into a battle of 'one-upmanship' over who is the neighborhood's resident superhero, but their competition is less than heroic. The day gets even stranger when Newt finds a four-leaf clover and has an amazing run of good luck!

programme.title: Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Fried Rice
programme.desc: Take a trip around the world in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Missy Hui hits the Great Wall running - her Chinese Fried Rice recipe is a classic complete with crispy bacon, crunchy onions and savoury scallions. Then, Poppy Sandler sets off for the Land of the Rising Sun with Crispy Sushi Rice and Spicy Tuna; sriracha mayo seasons the sushi-grade tuna and sticky short-grain rice cakes are fried (fried rice anyone?) to a beautiful golden-brown. Micah Trainor's Gorgonzola-Chive Arancini puts a Sicilian spin on frying rice - panko-crusted arborio is creamy and flavourful with blue cheese and chives for this ultra-indulgent Italian redux. Rice Papad with Turkey Tikka Masala is Tiera Singh's Indian extravaganza, taken to the top with puffy (fried, of course!) rice papad and tender braised turkey legs drenched in old school tomato-spice curry.

programme.title: Fennel Orange Salad
programme.desc: Host Tiera Singh gets the show on the road with her Italian- inspired Fennel Orange Salad. Seared sushi-grade tuna rests on top of a crunchy, zesty, tangy fennel and orange salad with a honey-vinegar dressing to sweeten it up! Micah Trainor's revamp? Five Spice Duck a L'Orange with a sugary caramelized orange sauce and duck fat fried potatoes - is it French? Chinese? Who knows, but it's delicious! Next, Poppy Sandler pulls off a vegetarian variation, with a Roasted Veggie Bouillabaisse, complete with musky morels, umami-packed kombu, and tender asparagus. Missy Hui finishes up with her Orange Licorice Panna Cotta - aromatic orange blossom honey and licorice-like fennel pollen make the dish a decadent denouement to this episode of Up the Dish!

programme.title: Pad Thai
programme.desc: This episode of Up the Dish brings a taste of Thailand to the screen as host Missy Hui makes everyone's favourite: Pad Thai. Succulent chicken thigh and semi-firm tofu are stir-fried with veggies and traditional Thai ingredients - tamarind, palm sugar, lime, sriracha, and fish sauce. Micah Trainor's up next - her Tequila-Lime Glazed Chicken Thighs come with veggie 'noodles' and are sweetened and spiced with agave syrup and chipotle peppers for a meal that feels like Mexico! Then Tiera Singh slips off to Seoul with her Korean BBQ Tofu - peanut buttery and spiked with homemade Korean BBQ sauce, the meaty tofu is wrapped up in lettuce and topped with tons of yummy veggies. Poppy Sandler ends at the beginning, swapping vanilla for bright Thai lemongrass and hot fresh ginger in her Lemongrass-Ginger CrÃ¨me Brulée, with torched Thai-inspired palm sugar for the classic, crunchy, burnt-sugar shell!

programme.title: Hawaiian Pizza
programme.desc: Host Micah Trainor's Hawaiian Pizza is the perfect salty- sweet piece of pie, with grilled pineapple and supERS-easy homemade pizza dough. That's dinner done, so Missy Hui handles dessert, with a Pineapple Upside-Down Cake covered in a homemade sea salt caramel. Next, colour is the core of Tiera Singh's vegan Rainbow Salad Rolls - juicy mango, creamy avocado, and crisp bibb lettuce are wrapped in rice paper for a vibrant veggie-filled dish. Then it's Poppy Sandler's turn to really Up the Dish... her response? Salty Miso and sweet Honey meet for her Black Cod with Sesame-Garlic Veggies! The marinated fish is seared and served over savoury veggies roasted in garlic- infused sesame oil.

programme.title: Have Fun
programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs make avocado toast and tacos, Liam whips up an easy pantry pasta, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make a favorite one pot meal!

programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs prep rainbow fruit skewers, Liam whips up his charity-inspired cheeseburger soup, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make a popular Trinidadian street food, fried bread and saltfish!

programme.title: Everybody’s A Chef
programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs make pancakes, Liam whips up craveable chicken coconut curry, Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make Nashville fried chicken sandwiches, and more!

programme.title: You Got It
programme.desc: Aspiring kid Chefs test kitchen hacks with eggs, Liam whips up the beef and broccoli stir fry he made for friends as a kid, while Jae-Anthony and his father Wendell make a beautiful pistachio pasta and Caesar salad!

programme.title: Vinegar
programme.desc: Chef and seafood expert Spencer Watts shows how vinegar, a simple pantry staple, can bring out the flavours of walleye, lobster and crawfish.

programme.title: Cocktails
programme.desc: Seafood lover and chef Spencer Watts brings the party to the kitchen and shows that cocktails aren't just for drinking, they're also an inspiration for cooking great seafood.

programme.title: Cold
programme.desc: Cooking doesn't always have to bring the heat. Chef and fish lover Spencer Watts shows you how to prepare cold dishes with arctic char and shrimp.

programme.title: Wrapped
programme.desc: Chef Spencer Watts has fun wrapping some of his favourite seafood to create delicious dishes with swordfish and shrimp.

programme.title: Spaghetti
programme.desc: Host Poppy Sandler kicks off Up the Dish with her version of mom's spaghetti - a scrumptious Spaghetti Pomodoro that takes it to the top! Next up to the plate is Missy Hui, who hits it out of the park with her heavenly Bun Viet, a sweet and sour vermicelli noodle bowl and citrusy lemongrass grilled pork combo. Then, Tiera Singh takes up the challenge with her vegetarian Miso Ramen - an umami flavour bomb of miso, mirin, and even more noodle goodness. But there's nowhere to go but up with Micah's Lobster Cantonese Chow Mein, an elegantly upscaled rendition of Chinese noodles with bright ginger, tender gai lan, and crisp chow mein, all coated in an exquisite black bean sauce.

programme.title: Moules Frites
programme.desc: Crack open a mussel or two, this episode of Up the Dish begins in Belgium, but please, no waffles! Host Micah Trainor makes Moules- Frites, mussels steamed in white wine and shows her trick for bistro- style French fries. Next, Tiera Singh steals the show with her Mussel Broth Vichyssoise and Smoked Mussels, an ultra-creamy cold soup that's paired with smoky shellfish for fantastic flavour. Vegetarian mussels? Missy Hui says "no worries!" and makes Saffron Artichokes with zesty Lemon Chili Oil - there's a little bit of everything in each delectable bite! How does Poppy Sandler send the episode off? By turning it on its head! Fried mussels with Celeriac Remoulade salad makes for a satisfying ending to Up the Dish.

programme.title: Dumplings
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui goes back to her childhood with Chicken and Dumplings - comfort food for every age! The chicken-dumpling journey doesn't end there; Micah Trainor turns the dish upside down and inside out with her Chinese-inspired Chicken-Chive Gyoza, a crunchy-crispy dim sum delight, with an ovERS-the-top chili sauce! How does Poppy Sandler spice things up? Herb Gnudi with Red Pepper Sauce, a spicy-savoury dumpling that's coated in nutty brown butter and creamy ricotta cheese for extra oomph. Tiera Singh finishes with another European dish - Spinach Spaetzle and Crispy Prosciutto, straight from Germany! Chewy spaetzle, fresh spinach, crispy ham - this textural treat doesn't let up!

programme.title: Lasagna
programme.desc: How do you make any lasagna recipe better? Ask Tiera Singh to take it up, of course! Her 'Nonna-style' bechamel and Bolognese-based Lasagna is topped with melty mozzarella for a luscious and luxuriant dish. Tiera tosses it over to Poppy Sandler, whose sideways Seafood Lasagna mixes up mussels, shrimp, and a briny bechamel sauce - yum! Next, Micah Trainor makes a dressed-up vegetarian version of the classic - her Zucchini-Mushroom Lasagna Rolls with tangy sundried tomatoes, savoury ricotta cheese, and earthy mushroom duxelles is simply superlative. Missy Hui hits the sweet spot with her Chocolate Raspberry Dessert Lasagna; layers of rich white chocolate, thick raspberry coulis, and velvety mascarpone cheese come together for a dessert that's in the stratosphere!

programme.title: Coconut and Crab
programme.desc: In this "C" challenge, Chef Robert Jewell cooks up recipes using coconut and crab before combining both into a single recipe. Using sweet coconut, Robert makes a classic dessert -- an irresistible coconut cream pie. He starts with a delectable crunchy graham cracker crust and tops his pie with fluffy whipped cream and toasted coconut flakes. Next, Robert transforms a fresh soft-shell crab into a delicious, spicy, and crunchy dish. The best part? It's fast and easy to make. After soaking the crab in milk, Robert dunks it into a flour-cornmeal mixture and fries it until golden brown. But that's not all, Robert whips up the perfect dipping sauce, using spicy smoked- jalapeno, lime, and orange adobo mayo. Finally, Robert brings coconut and crab into one delicious dish.

programme.title: Sesame and Scallops
programme.desc: It's all about sesame and scallops in this letter "S" challenge, and host Theresa Visintin has some appetizing ideas up her sleeve. First, she shows us how to make scallop cassoulet, a simple recipe that can be cooked even faster than it can eaten! Theresa browns the tender scallops in delicious bacon fat and then bakes it on a bed of creamy kidney beans. Next, Theresa uses sesame seeds to create a zesty sauce for a take-out favourite, made in your very own kitchen - noodles! For her final recipe, our culinary host combines sesame and scallops, creating a juicy, crunchy masterpiece.

programme.title: Tea and Turkey
programme.desc: Tea and turkey are an unlikely combo for a meal, but Chef Robert Jewell is a creative force in the kitchen. First, he gives earl grey and lavender tea a sweet treatment by making a rich semifreddo. Robert creates a silky tea infused syrup, which he drizzles over a luxurious custard and tops with whipped cream. Robert punches up the colour by adding tart poached raspberries and vibrant violet lavender petals. Now, it's time for a real show stopper - saffron turkey kebabs with pomegranate rice. This is not your average turkey dinner. First, Robert marinates the turkey pieces in lime, yogourt and garlic. After infusing basmati rice with aromatic saffron and bay leaves, Robert tosses the rice with crunchy pine nuts and sweet pomegranate - the perfect bed for his grilled to- perfection turkey skewers. Robert then takes his culinary skills to the next level when he uses tea and turkey in one single delicious dish.

programme.title: Mexico + Norway
programme.desc: In this episode of CombiNATION Plates, host Bianca Osbourne starts in Mexico with her version of popular street snack, 'Esquites', re-invented here as sweet corn flan. Next is Norway, don't miss explosively exciting quick-smoked Arctic Char with Forage, you've NEVER seen anything like this before. The common ingredient is tacos! programme.desc: Cheese or chocolate? Why not both! In this "C" challenge, host Theresa Visintin takes on both decadent ingredients. Theresa takes the flavour one step further by coating the stuffed chicken with sage, parmesan, and panko bread crumbs, then frying it to a crispy golden brown. Next, Theresa whips up a dessert fan favourite, the decadent and oh-so-irresistible dark chocolate lava cake. Finally, Theresa has an irresistible recipe using ooey gooey cheese and warm chocolate.

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

Lastly, chef Pino puts together some fluffy frittata-style muffins packed with tomato and spicy arugula leaves. Bravo brassicas!

programme.title: Bursts of Japanese Flavours
programme.desc: Host Hana Etsuke Dethlefsen makes casual Japanese cuisine like Savoury Japanese Pancakes and Gyoza three-ways.

programme.title: Salmon Salad Niçoise
programme.desc: How many ways can salmon be prepared? Up the Dish is on a mission to find out! Tiera Singh's Salmon Salad NiÃ§oise is a staple of the French Riviera with shallot, eggs, and haricot verts, but she swaps out the tuna for luxuriant olive oil poached salmon - it may not be traditional but it sure tastes good! Poppy Sandler smokes the competition with a buttery Smoked Salmon Omelette, garnished with fresh chives and earthy goat cheese. Next, Micah Trainor skips the salmon but keeps the veggies for her steamed Tofu Nori Dim Sum Dumplings, with tart gingERS-pickled shallots and tons of green goodness. Missy Hui has the big finish; her Salmon with Béarnaise is cooked sous vide for a precisely cooked fish dish and served alongside Pommes Anna for a plate that's straight out of Paris.

programme.title: Ireland + Japan
programme.desc: If you are talking about Irish food, it's hard not to talk about Corned Beef and Cabbage. On this episode of CombiNATION Plates, Chef Craig Wong delivers his unusual take using Beef Cheek, modern technique, and a caraway-infused Carrot Terrine for fun! Next up is a tribute to Izakaya eats, featuring Tare Grilled Duck Hearts, Miso-roasted Mushroom, and Agedashi Tofu. The featured common ingredient is Oysters. For Ireland, it's Garlic GratineÌe; for Japan, check out the Kaki Yaki, oysters broiled with miso and rich Japanese Kewpie mayo. For the final dish, light up! Smoking is permitted! Check out blowtorch-seared and tableside-smoked Wagyu Beef, brushed with Irish Stout Teriyaki and served with Wasabi Champ Potato. Now that's a CombiNation Plate!

programme.title: Dumplings
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui goes back to her childhood with Chicken and Dumplings - comfort food for every age! The chicken-dumpling journey doesn't end there; Micah Trainor turns the dish upside down and inside out with her Chinese-inspired Chicken-Chive Gyoza, a crunchy-crispy dim sum delight, with an ovERS-the-top chili sauce! How does Poppy Sandler spice things up? Herb Gnudi with Red Pepper Sauce, a spicy-savoury dumpling that's coated in nutty brown butter and creamy ricotta cheese for extra oomph. Tiera Singh finishes with another European dish - Spinach Spaetzle and Crispy Prosciutto, straight from Germany! Chewy spaetzle, fresh spinach, crispy ham - this textural treat doesn't let up!

programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: TO HAVE AND TO KILL
programme.desc: For most people, their wedding day ignites dreams of a bright future and the hope of fading into the sunset with the one they love. But for some brides and grooms, the reality of 'til death do you part' hits come sooner than expected.

programme.title: FLATHEADS FOREVER
programme.desc: Arnold brings Dan two interlocking projects. He wants FantomWorks to transform his 1946 Ford Panel Wagon into a classic tour-mobile, and he also wants Dan to fix the 1941 Harley Flathead motorcycle that will ride in the back.

programme.title: BRICK BY BRICKLIN
programme.desc: Walter brings his 1975 Bricklin back to FantomWorks with the hope that Dan can fix problems that were created when it was built. And then add missiles. Tim’s 1954 Imperial hasn’t run in decades and everything on the car is locked up solid.

programme.title: PRE-MARITAL MASSACRE
programme.desc: On the eve of their wedding Emely and Manuel and his brother Jose are gunned down in their front yard. What provoked this massacre, and will anyone survive it?

programme.title: METRO MAYHEM (PART 1)
programme.desc: David and Chuck want their family heirloom 1961 International Harvester Metro Van converted into a state-of-the-art restomod, with all the trimmings. David asks Dan to find and restore a very specific car he’s always wanted: a 1966 Lincoln Convertible.

programme.title: METRO MAYHEM (PART 2)
programme.desc: FantomWorks epic 4 year long wrestling match with the 1961 International Harvester Metro concludes with an incredible, one-of-a-kind van. Ray wants his 1969 ZL1 to match the number 68 rally car, but he needs Dan’s rare Winters stamped 427 COPO motor.

programme.title: MUSIC HALL BONES
programme.desc: Guatemala for nearly 36 years was also a country ripped apart by a brutal civil war between the military government and the rural Mayan population. In 1996, the United Nations brokered the final cease-fire. Mass graves now mar the countryside and efforts sanctioned by the present government have been underway to uncover, identify and properly rebury the dead. Dr. Clyde Snow, a world-renowned forensic anthropologist, has been traveling to Guatemala since 1991, when he first trained local archaeology students and helped set up a forensic lab in Guatemala City. He has invited Dr. Elizabeth Murray to observe and join in on the work being done by the crew there. Snow and Murray will travel into the jungle where one of the Guatemalan teams is presently excavating a mass grave site. They will also spend time in the lab in Guatemala City where Dr. Murray will have an opportunity to examine some of the remains and talk with various "technicians" about the forensic anthropological methods they use to aid in their identifications. For the Mayan survivors, it is of the utmost importance to them that the victims be identified, their injuries noted, and that proper burial take place. For this reason, after remains are studied and documented by the anthropology teams, a repatriation and reburial ceremony is carried out. Dr. Murray, joined by some members of the Guatemalan crew, will be present for one of these solemn testimonials to the importance of this work. On this episode of Skeleton Crew, though decades may have passed, the bones are alive with many stories to tell.

programme.title: INFANT MORTALITY
programme.desc: On the morning of January 23, 1994, a slumber party in Alvin, Texas becomes the scene of a terrible tragedy when Two and a half -year-old Renee Goode is discovered dead. The mother of the child accuses her estranged husband, but when the medical examiner rules the death undetermined, the investigation draws to a close. The girl’s vigilant mother and grandmother mount an investigation of their own and are soon joined by a detective and Brazoria County Assistant District Attorney Jeri Yenne. It will be up to them to find the cause of the young girl’s death and bring to justice the man responsible, Michael Shane Goode, her own father.

programme.title: SOLDIER STORIES
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: INFAMOUSE COLORADO CANNIBAL
programme.desc: It was a flood of biblical proportion rampaging for two months, cutting a swath across 9 Midwestern states killing 50 people and destroying or damaging 55,000 homes. Hardin, Missouri, population a little over 600, was a small, close-knit farming community. Residents watched over each other and their history by taking exceptional care of the local cemetery where their ancestors rested. What the inhabitants of this small Missouri town came to realize was that the Great Midwest Flood of 1993 would have the ability to unearth the dead as the Missouri river flowed three and a half miles over its banks. The floodwaters ate through the Hardin cemetery, unearthing hundreds of headstones, vaults and caskets, sending them through the streets and fields of Ray County. As the disaster unfolded, a special team comprised of local volunteers and forensic anthropologists, pathologists and other specialists brought together by DMORT (Disaster Mortuary Operational Response Team) came from as far away as Washington, DC in a massive effort to recover, identify, and repatriate the hundreds of individuals exhumed by the floodwaters. On this episode of Skeleton Crew, Dr. Elizabeth Murray and some members of this unique crew will re-explore the extraordinary efforts that were undertaken to once again bring to rest the displaced remains, and provide closure for the living.

programme.title: CAREER CRIMINAL
programme.desc: A loving mother disappears without explanation in Arlington, Texas. Investigators suspect foul play but search fruitlessly for any sign of her whereabouts. When investigators discover a link between the woman’s disappearance and another murder nearly two decades earlier, they contact Prosecutor Sandy Gately. It will be up to her to re-open a 16-year-old case and work with limited evidence to bring bring to justice a criminal responsible for multiple murders.

programme.title: DEAD MED DO TALK
programme.desc: Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: MASS GRAVES OF GUATEMALA
programme.desc: From as early as 1876, there were rumors of ghosts inhabiting the building that now houses the Cincinnati Symphony, so when a night watchman would tell of his sightings nearly 100 years later, many thought he was just adding to lore. But then in 1988 when construction workers were working in one of the elevator shafts, they uncovered hundreds of pounds of skeletal remains in an underground crypt. Dr. Elizabeth Murray was eventually entrusted with the bones and set about to solve the mystery; how did these bones end up where they did and who might these individuals be? Records would eventually indicate that the original building that would eventually become today’s Music Hall was built atop the city’s nineteenth century public burial ground for commoners and indigents. The bones themselves would paint a picture of Cincinnati’s first settlers. On this episode of Skeleton Crew, Dr. Elizabeth Murray will take us back in time and tell us how she, as a forensic anthropologist, along with the assistance of a small crew of experts, was able to solve this mystery.

programme.title: SILENCER
programme.desc: On September 18, 1985, the life of a small-town bank president is shattered when he receives a call from an unknown man who has kidnapped his wife. The kidnapper demands a ransom for her safe return. When local police respond to the home, they find the woman dead, shot seven times. The FBI is called in and an intense investigation ensues. The case is broken when a man comes forward with the murder weapon, leading to two arrests. With the testimony of one of the co-conspirators and a mountain of circumstantial evidence, it would be up to Assistant District Attorneys Sam Ponder and Charlie Strauss to prove that Lesley Lee Gosch was the mastermind of the extortion plot, and a remorseless murderer.

programme.title: THE REAL JEWELS OF SOUTH AFRICA
programme.desc: Hosts Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger journey to the heart of South Africa, where they reveal that the nation’s true brilliance shines not from its famous diamonds, but from the resilience and spirit of its people. The episode begins in Johannesburg, a city forged by gold and hardened by resistance. Kolyn and Lindsey delve into the profound legacy of Nelson Mandela, tracing his transformation from an activist to a revolutionary leader who introduced the mining charter. This segment explores how a history of struggle became a foundation for national strength. The narrative shifts from social history to the literal 'sparkle' of the land with a trip to the Kimberley Big Hole. Here, the team explores the origins of the global diamond rush. They meet Molefi Letsiki, a Diamondtaires and the world’s first Black Sightholder—one of only 70 globally—whose success is a testament to a legacy fulfilled. The deep dive continues 1,500 feet underground at the Venetia Mine. This offers a high-stakes, never-before-seen look at modern diamond production, highlighting the industry's critical shift toward community empowerment and sustainability. The episode concludes by examining the 'Future' of the facet. It showcases how South Africa's ancient craft and natural resources are being re-embraced by a new generation of leaders, artists, and entrepreneurs. Through every interview—from museum educators to diamond executives—one message remains clear: while the diamonds may glisten, the people are The Real Jewels Of South Africa.

programme.desc: From as early as 1876, there were rumors of ghosts inhabiting the building that now houses the Cincinnati Symphony, so when a night watchman would tell of his sightings nearly 100 years later, many thought he was just adding to lore. But then in 1988 when construction workers were working in one of the elevator shafts, they uncovered hundreds of pounds of skeletal remains in an underground crypt. Dr. Elizabeth Murray was eventually entrusted with the bones and set about to solve the mystery; how did these bones end up where they did and who might these individuals be? Records would eventually indicate that the original building that would eventually become today’s Music Hall was built atop the city’s nineteenth century public burial ground for commoners and indigents. The bones themselves would paint a picture of Cincinnati’s first settlers. On this episode of Skeleton Crew, Dr. Elizabeth Murray will take us back in time and tell us how she, as a forensic anthropologist, along with the assistance of a small crew of experts, was able to solve this mystery.

programme.title: MATERIAL WITNESS
programme.desc: The FBI suspects’ fraudulent business practices are linked to the mysterious disappearance of Candor Diamond Corporation president, Irwin Margolies. Weeks after Margolies turns up, and begins cooperating with authorities, several Candor employees are now the victims of brutal murders. The deaths all point to the work of a hired hit man, with possible links to Margolies, but it will take the concentrated efforts of federal agents to untangle the web of clues to convict the killers.

programme.title: SOUTH AFRICA UNCORKED: SOUL, SEA & SAFARI
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger venture beyond the mountains to explore the vibrant soul of South Africa, from the high-adrenaline wild of Kruger National Park to the trailblazing spirit of its first Black-owned winery. The journey begins in Mpumalanga, 'the place where the sun rises,' for an immersive safari experience in Kruger National Park. Accompanied by their daughter, Kynsley, the team experiences nature’s masterpiece firsthand, discovering that the 'wild' is as much about preservation as it is about the thrill of discovery. The narrative then shifts to Cape Town, a global cosmopolitan hub where the Atlantic and Indian Oceans meet. Standing atop the iconic Table Mountain, the hosts reflect on its history as a 'gift to the world' from Nelson Mandela. Deepening their cultural exploration, Kolyn and Lindsey visit the Lesedi Cultural Village to experience the living history of the Zulu people through dance, rhythm, and traditional delicacies. The celebration of South African excellence culminates at Klein Goederust, the first and only 100% Black-owned winery in the Franschhoek Valley. Through a moving conversation with founder Paul Siguqa, the episode highlights a legacy of resilience—transforming generations of farm labor into a future of ownership and Black excellence.

programme.title: Guardians of the Wild

programme.title: Guardians of the Wild

programme.title: Land of Primates

programme.title: Land of Primates

programme.desc: Koalas may seem solitary and inert, but mating season brings a dramatic shift in their behavior, leading to movement, contact, and conflict.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Join the Shark Family as they work hard to keep the sea clean! It's a busy day with so much rubbish on the seabed. Stanley Shark becomes his heroic alter-ego, Super Shark, to show everyone how to clean up and recycle properly! The Sharksons show their creativity by using recycled materials to build an amazing underwater ball pit and slide. Plus, see them use teamwork to operate little digger trucks and even fix a broken bus wheel using a sunken bin lid!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join Digley and Dazey as they face the biggest, craziest disasters! First, a big thunderstorm hits while the crew is working, and they have to rescue Scout after she gets trapped down a hole! Then, while working on a railway bridge, an earthquake causes it to almost fall apart, and the team must fix it before a train crosses! From escaping an avalanche they accidentally caused on a mountain to helping a baby lion that has escaped from the zoo, it's a day of big disasters!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Get ready for some construction chaos and clever fixes! First, Mr. Rubble is very tired and puts the plans on the board upside down, causing the crew to build a house upside down! Then, while building a roundabout, the crew finds some big old dinosaur bones! The chaos continues as a power cut stops all their machines, so they hook everything up to clean solar panels instead. From building a pond for frogs to building themselves into a box, it's always chaotic!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Come sing your favorite classic songs with Kii and Yii! The sing-along starts on Old MacDonald's farm, where the friends learn how to spell the friendly dog's name in the song 'Bingo'! Then, listen as Mr. Cat sings a story about his grand adventure visiting the Queen in her palace. The fun continues with the story of the Lion and the Unicorn, the flying adventure of 'Two Little Dicky Birds' and a song about the Old Woman Who Lived in a Shoe.

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate teamwork and rescue special with Kii and Yii! The adventure begins when Princess Cat is flying her plane but gets in a sticky jammy mess, causing her to lose control! It's up to Kii and Yii to get her down safely. Then, the friends are playing near Princess Cat's castle when she accidentally falls down the well and needs to be rescued again! From helping Humpty Dumpty to rounding up runaway vegetables, Kii and Yii always save the day!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John for a fun day at school! First, he learns that karate can be challenging, but with a lot of practice, he learns how to kick, punch and move! Then, he learns how to play soccer with the help of his big brother and sister. The day continues with a special surprise guest who drops in and teaches the gang how to play different instruments, like the piano, trumpet and guitar! It's always a fun day of learning at school!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: What should Baby John be when he grows up? Join him as he explores different fun jobs! First, it's race day for Baby John and Manny! They each choose a vehicle to test on the racetrack: an ice cream truck against an ambulance! Then, it's superhero day at daycare, and Manny arrives in a luchador outfit. Everyone is curious, so he explains that luchadores are Mexican superheroes! The fun continues as Baby John drives a bus and picks up friends dressed in different professions.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: It's time to play at home with Baby John and the family! First, they get everything ready for a fun movie night in the backyard, complete with popcorn and a projector. Then, the kids make a crazy bubble machine that makes bubbles of all sizes and colors, but it gets a little out of control! The fun at home continues as the kids plan a surprise romantic dinner for Mom and Dad and create a sock puppet show!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Get creative this learning month! Master your ABCs with alphabet cereal and put on a play about yummy vegetables. Learn what colors make purple to finish a painting and help Baby John figure out what's inside his birthday presents.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate creative challenge with Baby John! He wants to build a snowman, but it's the middle of summer! When he sees Manny playing in the mud, he has a great idea to build a mudman instead! Then, the boys work together to make muffins, but they get a little too carried away and make a big mess in the kitchen. The creative challenges continue as the boys try to build a London Bridge that won't fall down!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John as he learns about all the things he can be when he grows up! His adventure starts with a school trip to the fire station, where the kids learn what to do in an emergency and how firefighters are true superheroes! Then, he learns about all the different community helpers, like police officers and doctors. The learning continues as he discovers all about traffic lights and road safety while playing with his new toy car.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for some fun learning adventures at home! First, TomTom leads his lab assistants JJ and YoYo in some amazing science experiments, from making slime to building an erupting volcano! Then, it's time to head to the kitchen, where YoYo teaches JJ how to make the perfect peanut butter and jelly sandwich. The at-home fun continues as the kids discover a cassette player and record all the cool sounds they hear around the house!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: JJ is learning all about how to share, help and be kind! First, he learns the magic words 'please' and 'thank you,' and what to do when you make a mistake. The lessons continue as JJ, YoYo and TomTom show how much fun it is to share their snacks and toys. Being kind also means being helpful, and JJ's family loves to help each other around the house. From using good manners at the table to learning how to wait in line, it's a day of learning to be a good friend and family member!

programme.title: CeCe Time
programme.desc: It's CeCe Time, full of kittens, tutus and fun! The big day arrives when CeCe gets her very own adorable kitten! She loves her new friend and wants to put on a show, so she gets in her ballerina outfit to dance for her kitty. Then, after hosting many tea parties for her stuffed animals, CeCe invites her real friends JJ and Bella over for a high tea party! From ice skating with Mom to imagining stick ponies are unicorns, it's always a fun and graceful day with CeCe!

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: It's time to sing, play and learn with all of JJ's animal pals! The fun begins as JJ hosts a big talent show in the clubhouse where all his friends get to showcase their unique skills, from magic to circus tricks! Then, everyone joins in for a fun game of 'Follow the Leader,' where JJ learns that a little encouragement goes a long way. Plus, sing along as the friends learn all the different sounds the animals make and help Humpty Dumpty when he keeps falling off a wall!

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Join Buster as he uses his brains to save the day! When he overloads the carwash with bubble mix, he gets trapped in a giant bubble and floats away! He has to use all his smarts to find a way back down. Then, when Amber the Ambulance crashes and can't move, there's a big emergency! Buster has to muster up his courage and become a 'Hero Ambulance Bus' to save his best friend Scout from a broken bridge.

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Go on a learning adventure with Buster! Help build a duck bridge for a family of ducks and draw big colorful shapes on the ground. Learn that even when you make mistakes at school, telling the truth is always the best thing to do.

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: It's the whole crew to the rescue in these amazing adventures! When Kat doesn't know a car's throttle is stuck, she goes for a test drive and is soon out of control, forcing Grandma and Gecko to rescue her! Then, when a beach trip is cancelled because Tilly the Tow Truck breaks down, Trevor helps with a tow and then delivers a load of sand to create a surprise beach right at the garage! Plus, the whole crew jumps into action when Blue gets stranded alone down a steep bank.

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Gecko and the Mechanicals face a big test of skill and teamwork! First, the Mechs are in Garage School when a real emergency comes in. In a role reversal, they must fix Fiona the Firetruck's starter motor while Gecko instructs them! Then, when Blue crashes during a flying race, Gecko must show his skill to repair him. The day ends with a big American football game where Gecko comes up with a clever strategy and a creative fix to help his team win!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for adventure as Arpo's imagination runs wild! After a bump on the head, Arpo is convinced he's a pirate, leading the family on a swashbuckling adventure for treasure. Then, Arpo builds an epic backyard rollercoaster for Daniel, but it's up to Totbot to save the day when it goes out of control! The learning continues with a fun animal bus ride, a trip to space to sing 'Hey Diddle Diddle' and an important lesson on how to cross the road carefully with a mother cat and her kitten.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for some fun learning adventures at home! First, TomTom leads his lab assistants JJ and YoYo in some amazing science experiments, from making slime to building an erupting volcano! Then, it's time to head to the kitchen, where YoYo teaches JJ how to make the perfect peanut butter and jelly sandwich. The at-home fun continues as the kids discover a cassette player and record all the cool sounds they hear around the house!

programme.title: Cody Time
programme.desc: Spend a day at home with Cody and his family! Join Cody as he goes to work with his dad, Kwame, at the bakery, where they take on a huge muffin order and deliver them on time. Then, the kids get a special lesson in culture as Kwame introduces them to African instruments like the Balafon and Sangba drum. The day continues with Cody helping his dad cook delicious dishes from Ghana and ends with Mom and Dad comforting him after a bad dream.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Go on a big family adventure with Baby John! The fun starts with a road trip to visit the Grand Canyon, where the family learns all about their RV along the way. Then, the family divides into two teams, sailors vs. pirates, for a fun and competitive game of mini golf! The adventure continues as Jill is feeling a little nervous for her first parade, but with the help of her friends, she learns to march and spin her baton in no time!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Learn to be brave and helpful with Baby John! Help Dad fix the car, say 'yes' to sunscreen and floaties before swimming, and drive an ambulance to save the day. Help chase a runaway sheep and learn about the importance of safety at home.

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: Ahoy, mateys! Join JJ for pirate songs and fun beach games! The adventure begins when JJ and Wally play pirates on the high seas but can't agree on where to find the hidden treasure! Then, when a wave washes away their sandcastle, a little crab helps them try again to build one that's nearly indestructible. The pirate fun continues as Wally tries to swipe JJ's five little duckies during bath time, leading to a sudsy chase to find the ducknapper!

programme.title: Cody Time
programme.desc: Have a playdate with Cody! Solve the mystery of the disappearing buses, help Mom in the garden with a digger toy, and race motor trikes with JJ. Get ready to be a big brother, move to a new house, and learn to share your red wagon.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi on an adventure to the wonders of our world and beyond! First, he travels to the tallest mountain on Earth, Mt. Everest, with his new friend Betty the Yeti. Then, he dives deep into the ocean to explore a kelp forest with Jerry the Jellyfish. The adventure gets explosive as Blippi and FETCH fly into a volcano! After exploring the Earth, Blippi blasts off into space to tour the solar system, learn about gravity on the moon and discover how rainbows get their amazing colors!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is answering some of life's biggest questions! He shrinks down for a night adventure in a mouth to learn the right way to brush teeth from Bill Brushy. Then, he flies up a nose to find out what makes us sneeze! His curiosity continues as he learns how a fly can walk upside down on the ceiling, discovers the artistic process of how spiders make their webs and even becomes a contestant on a game show to learn the difference between fruits and vegetables!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is learning awesome facts about all kinds of animals! He and D.BO travel back in time to meet the biggest dinosaurs, like the Argentinosaurus, and even try to keep a T-Rex as a pet for a day! Back in the present, they shrink down to count a shark's teeth with a pilot fish dentist. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how elephants use their trunks to keep cool and discovers why cats have whiskers from a local feline celebrity.

programme.title: The Melon Patch
programme.desc: Celebrate the joy of music with the Melon Patch teachers! Learn about different instruments, move your body to the beat, and listen to the sounds of nature. Discover how you can use music to express yourself through hands-on, playful fun.

programme.title: The Melon Patch
programme.desc: Explore the world of colors with Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers. Through playful discovery, learn to identify colors by name, mix them to create new ones, and use them in the things you make, eat, and play with every day.

programme.title: Cody Time
programme.desc: Join Cody for a day of fun! Ride the bus with JJ, help Dad cook delicious food from Ghana, and have a special hair wash day. Play peek-a-boo, get a check-up at the doctor's, and make alphabet soup in this exciting collection!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for a nature walk and some of his favorite rhymes! First, JJ's family shows him all the fun things we can do to help the Earth, like sorting trash for recycling. Then, the kids go on a nature walk with Bingo, collecting fun information in their scrapbooks! After the outdoor fun, it's time for classic rhymes. Sing along as ten animal friends try to share a bed and help the three little kittens who have lost their mittens!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Settle down for the night with a collection of the best bedtime songs! Bake cupcakes with Grandma Panda, help your little brother get to sleep with a lullaby, and learn to wait patiently for morning with a special clock.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Go on an exciting sing-along adventure with Baby John! Help Jill find a lost lamb's mommy and perform in a Baby Shark play at school. Help the Itsy Bitsy spider overcome challenges and drive a delivery truck with your family.

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Mom's crazy inventions are going haywire! First, Arpo and Daniel have fun with the new voice-controlled smart house, until it starts having a tantrum and they have to figure out how to calm it down. Then, Mom's new time travel machine accidentally turns a pigeon into a giant pterodactyl, forcing Arpo to catch it! The mayhem continues when Daniel takes a flying smartcrib on a joyride and Arpo has to chase a remote-controlled truck that's gone out of control!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for adventure as Arpo's imagination runs wild! After a bump on the head, Arpo is convinced he's a pirate, leading the family on a swashbuckling adventure for treasure. Then, Arpo builds an epic backyard rollercoaster for Daniel, but it's up to Totbot to save the day when it goes out of control! The fantasy continues when Arpo accidentally creates a giant, sentient jelly monster that takes over the entire house and needs to be stopped!

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: Join Ella for a super fun day at Lellobee City Farm! First, when a nest of baby duck eggs starts to hatch, Ella has to play 'Mummy Duck' to keep all the cute but runaway ducklings together! Then, Rishi organizes all the animals for a friendly game of soccer, where everyone learns each other's animal sounds. The fun day ends with a new arrival, as Ella and Mei find and adopt a stray cat named Bingo, welcoming him to his new home!

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: It's time to sing, dance and play at Lellobee City Farm! The fun starts in the Boogie Barn where Grandma Mei teaches Ella, Rishi and all the cute animals a brand new alphabet song. Then, it's time to get active as Mei leads a high-energy exercise dance for all the kids and animals! The day ends with a fun 'who can make the biggest splash?' competition in the inflatable swimming pool, where even Pablo the pig and Heidi the horse join in!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Get ready for the most unpredictable magic mishaps! First, Magic Pet Chroma accidentally takes away all the colors from the city, and Morphle must morph into a magic paintbrush to paint them all back. Then, Professor Paula's new youth serum is accidentally spilled on Mila, turning her into a baby! Now Morphle has to look after baby Mila while an antidote is created. The mishaps continue as giant bubbles carry away citizens and a giant living doll causes chaos!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Welcome to the wacky world of Winston and Orphle! First, Winston tricks a Magic Pet into growing his robots of Mila and Morphle big enough to steal the entire Magic Pet Center! Then, Orphle causes trouble on his own when he runs away with the cake Mila made for her and Morphle's Matchiversary. The two troublemakers team up to try and get their hands on a special surprise gift, but it's up to Mila and Morphle to stop them!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Sing and play all day long! Give a sheep a bath on the farm, wait out the rain on a camping trip, and find out who the mysterious Muffin Man is. Have a surprise party in the treehouse and get ready for the day with TomTom and YoYo!

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: Go on a food and fun adventure! Convince Wally to try tacos, save Humpty Dumpty from falling, and find an island of apples and bananas. Explore the sea in a shark submarine, learn not to fear the dark and fly to the moon to see if it's cheese!

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: The Minibods are learning about heroes, sharing, honesty and eating greens! When Lulu loses her favorite bunny, Bubbles comes to the rescue and becomes her personal superhero! Then, Jeff is excited to read a new book but refuses to include his friends, so he must learn the joy of sharing a story. The lessons continue as Pogo accidentally ruins Newt's teddy-shaped hedge and learns to tell the truth, and Fuse finds the courage to eat his healthy Oddsprouts!

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: It's a day of yummy adventures with fruits, cupcakes, snacks and ice cream! Pogo wants to pick a delicious fruit from a tree, but he hilariously learns that he has to be patient and wait for it to ripen! Then, Lulu is determined to bake a cupcake all by herself, but her mixture turns into a giant cupcake blob that takes over the Playpod! Plus, Fuse is craving a snack but can't get the box open and Pogo's ice cream keeps melting!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on adventures big and small, from the mail to outer space! First, Blippi shrinks down to go inside the BlippiMobile's engine to fix a problem. Then, he follows a letter he wrote on its entire journey through the post office to Grandpa Blippi's mailbox! After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity and performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: Move your feet to these great songs! Dance with talking vegetables, sing 'Itsy Bisty Spider' in Spanish, and find your happy place at the beach or in the jungle. Learn animal sounds, copy your friends' dance moves, and march with bugs!

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate clubhouse game day with JJ and his friends! The competition heats up as JJ and Wally compete in an adrenaline-pumping go-kart race full of fun tricks and obstacles. Then, it's time for a silly game of hide-and-seek, where Boba finds the most clever hiding places! The games continue with a balloon boat race, a round of Duck Duck Goose and a clean-up dance party after the clubhouse gets messy. It's a day packed with fun and friendly competition!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John in a world of imaginative sing-alongs! Build your own bus at school, learn the chicken dance, and overcome your fears with Itsy Bitsy spider. Dress up as a police officer and drive an ambulance to save the day!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Get ready to play together and have fun with Baby John and his friends! Baby John and Manny spend an exciting day at the pool, where they learn to follow all the safety procedures. Then, the two get a little competitive at the playground as they try to outdo each other building sandcastles and playing soccer. The fun continues as the boys set up their very own car wash after getting their electric cars all muddy!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: It's a day of crazy competitions and robot malfunctions! First, a friendly competition in the park turns into a wild go-kart race between Arpo and his rival, Nannybot! Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire. A toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably all over the backyard, and a malfunctioning birthday present massage chair chases him and Daniel around the house! From boomerang target practice to a building block showdown, the chaos never stops!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Arpo and Baby Daniel are causing chaos all over town! The adventure starts at the supermarket when Daniel runs off with a giant lollipop, leading to a wild chase with Arpo's rockets on the fritz. Then, a relaxing fishing picnic turns into a wilderness survival test when a thieving squirrel tries to steal their food! Plus, the family gets a mischievous new puppy that Arpo has to keep from making messes and a stroller goes on the loose, forcing Arpo to chase it through town!

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: The Minibods are dealing with a messy guest, a cracked egg, a hoppy friend and a ruined teddy! Jeff meets a cute but very messy Floofer and has to learn to live with his new friend's untidy habits. Then, Lulu finds a colorful egg, and when it cracks, a cute chick hatches that she doesn't want to let go! The challenges continue as Newt tries to nurse an injured Oddfrog back to health and Pogo feels guilty after accidentally ruining Newt's teddy bear-shaped hedge.

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: It's a day of learning lessons at parties and games! Pogo is invited to Jeff's party, but Pogo wants it to be energetic while Jeff wants it to be calm, so they must learn to compromise. Then, Newt is desperate to win a gold star at Fuse's gym challenges, but she keeps losing! She has to learn to persevere and not give up. The lessons continue as Lulu learns to wait her turn at a funfair and Fuse finds the courage to eat his healthy greens.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Drift off to sleep with these gentle bedtime songs and lullabies. Learn the alphabet in the bath, say goodnight to all the families in town and get cozy with your favorite teddy bear. This collection is perfect for a peaceful night's sleep.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Join Twinkle the star for her most magical moments! When Max, Muffin and Bao Bao build a toy train, Twinkle transforms into a real train and takes the kids on a ride all around the house! Then, when Max pretends he's a wizard, Twinkle turns into a magic wand to make his magic real! Her powers continue as she brings fruits and veggies to life for a puppet show and turns into a giant wibbly-wobbly jelly for everyone to play on! It's always magical with Twinkle!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum: Lullabies
programme.desc: Little Baby Bum is here to help you fall to sleep; with soothing, relaxing animated lullabies. These gentle and sensory videos are accompanied by lullaby versions of much loved nursery rhymes, helping to take you to the land of nod.

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Go on a magical sky adventure with Twinkle! First, discover the variety of cloud shapes and sizes, from triangles and squares to star-shaped clouds! Then, daydream high in the clouds with Twinkle and Mr. Moon, where her magical stardust makes the moon sneeze and keeps changing colors! The sky-high fun continues as Twinkle soars through the sky on a magical journey to explore all the vibrant colors of the rainbow.

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Join Twinkle for some fun adventures and sleepy songs! First, help Twinkle find Sandy the Seagull while learning what sounds a pig, duck and cow make along the way! Then, Bunny leads Twinkle on an exciting adventure into the forest to find a mysterious box. After a long day of playing, it's time for some sleepy songs. Listen as Mr. Moon sings a soothing lullaby to help Twinkle drift off to sleep for a peaceful night's rest.

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: The Sharksons are using their brains for some clever underwater fixes! When all the contents of Tucker's bag fall out from a hole in his backpack, Stanley and Grub help him fix it so he can get to school. Then, when Grub can't get to sleep because she's afraid of the dark, Stanley has a clever idea to make a 'star' night light from a glove that floated down. From turning veggies into a fun game to sorting recycling, there's always a clever fix!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Join the Shark Family as they work hard to keep the sea clean! It's a busy day with so much rubbish on the seabed. Stanley Shark becomes his heroic alter-ego, Super Shark, to show everyone how to clean up and recycle properly! The Sharksons show their creativity by using recycled materials to build an amazing underwater ball pit and slide. Plus, see them use teamwork to operate little digger trucks and even fix a broken bus wheel using a sunken bin lid!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Get ready for playground games and construction fun! First, the crew has to build a crazy golf course! After they finish, they decide to try it out, but something goes wrong every time! Then, at the beach, Digley and Dazey challenge each other to a sandcastle competition. They each build castles that get bigger and sillier, and after some bickering, they decide to build one giant castle together! Plus, learn the alphabet and sing 'If You're Happy and You Know It'!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join the crew for some fun competitions and a day of helping friends! First, the friends compete in a fun obstacle course to see who can finish the race the fastest and lift the special trophy! Then, just as the crew is ready to demolish an old building, a cute cat hops inside, and the team must rescue the kitten before finishing the job. The helping continues as they save another kitten from a dangerous situation and Dazey must think fast to save Mrs. Skip from a runaway river barge!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Join Kii and Yii for songs about feeling good and staying safe! First, learn the best way to get a healthy smile in a fun and educational song about how to brush your teeth properly. Then, learn how to be safe when you're riding a bike at the playground. The lessons continue as Kii and Yii sing about being kind to each other, especially when a friend is sick. From learning colors to singing a soothing lullaby, these songs will make you feel good!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: It's time to play all the best games with Kii and Yii! The fun begins with a high-stakes game of Red Light, Green Light, where Jeepbot is 'It' with a slime cannon blaster! Then, Kii and Yii play a fun game of life-size Snakes and Ladders, complete with toy snakes and big ladders. The competition continues with a game of Duck, Duck, Goose in mini race cars and a summer pool party game of Marco Polo with Snappy Croc!

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: Ahoy, mateys! Join JJ for pirate songs and fun beach games! The adventure begins when JJ and Wally play pirates on the high seas but can't agree on where to find the hidden treasure! Then, when a wave washes away their sandcastle, a little crab helps them try again to build one that's nearly indestructible. The pirate fun continues as Wally tries to swipe JJ's five little duckies during bath time, leading to a sudsy chase to find the ducknapper!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Spend a whole day with JJ, from morning to night! Wake up and get ready with the family as JJ learns his morning routine. Then, it's off to a big adventure: JJ's first day of preschool! He's a little nervous, but he makes new friends and has lots of fun. After a full day of playing, it's time to get ready for bed. Mommy guides JJ through his nighttime routine of brushing his teeth, taking a bath and reading a story before he drifts off to sleep.

programme.title: Where is it?
programme.desc: During a game of hide and seek Deedee and Nino come across a panicky Mewmew who cannot locate his key. Deedee creates a spell to get back all of Mewmew’s missing things and in come his key, including his long lost bubble-cordion and pocket fork. But Mewmew doesn’t want those things back as he had already replaced them. So Deedee offers to keep them as she couldn’t stand the sight of them being thrown away. On the way they find Charlie hiding from his lost but newly found alarm clock that is chasing him. The clock won’t let Charlie sleep a bit by ringing all the time, so Deedee offers to take it along with the rest. Deedee gets many more additions to her lost and found group as many more citizens of Abra-Dabra are affected with lost things. But as Deedee doesn’t have any space to store them, she puts up a give-away store. Now everyone’s happy.

programme.title: Meep Meep Charlie's
programme.desc: Boris and Sandy are fighting over the water sprayer and drenching Uncle Charlie with it. This leaves Charlie with no choice but to call on Deedee’s magic. Deedee finds a spell to make friendship dust as the perfect solution. Whoever the dust falls on will be best friends with whoever they see first. Happy for getting the magic powder they all set off to see Boris and Sandy. But on the way the Doobydoos rush at them so suddenly that they fall all over them and the Doobydoos become friends of Charlie and carry him off. Nino tries to explain the situation to Deedee, but she is too busy to listen. Back over at Charlie’s, the Doobydoos are treating him as a king and tries to run away from his new friends. Deedee finds some of the missing magic powder but tries to find Charlie. Deedee tries to bring things back to normal with magic, but Nino is against it. They find a way to get the twins to work together and splash the Doobydoos with water and wash off the friendship dust. The twins are friends again even though Deedee’s magic didn’t work as expected.

programme.title: Colour Chaos
programme.desc: Mayor decide what colour to paint the town hall as it is so dull and grey. So Deedee offers to help, without magic this time, by getting a town vote as to which colour is liked best. Deedee and Nino go ahead and do just that, asking each and everybody they see in Abra-Dabra and noting their choice of colours. Boris and Sandy are confused so set out to paint and decide, but end up messing up the wall. They seek the help of Deedee, who is all so ready to help. But Nino is scared things will get worse with the powerful magic spell, and with good reason. The spell not only "cleaned" Charlie’s wall but made grey stripes on the walls of every house in Abra-Dabra! Even Tiggy’s yellow house is all grey!! So Deedee and everybody else pitch in and paint every house back to its original colour. So the final building standing is the town hall, but no one has sufficient pain for any one colour. So they finally decide to paint it with every colour they have, like a rainbow!

programme.title: Tiggy's Big Feast
programme.desc: Tiggy is all flustered and confused as he’s not prepared, nor has any idea what to make for a surprise lunch he promised Mayor De Pfeffel. Seems Deedee’s magic is the only answer. The spell she conjures makes Tiggy be totally decided on the recipe that he sees first. And when the spell is cast, the recipe book opens up exactly at the recipe of a pie made of Tika Pila flowers. The problem is that only the Doobydoos can pick the Tika Pila flowers as it grows in the most prickly cacti in Abra-Dabra! But no matter how much Deedee and Nino coax Tiggy to work on another recipe; Tiggy is totally fixated on the Tika Pila flower pie. Though the Doobydoos love eating the flowers, they are too scared of the loud and angry Tika Pila monster that guards them and rush off in a hurry. They finally hit a bargain with Tiggy in exchange for a hundred custard sandwiches. Only with much reassuring and coaxing they pick every Tika Pila flower around. Mayor De Pfeffel is already at Tiggy’s and really hungry. But one Doobydoo is too ambitious and stays back to pick the last Tika Pila flower, but that awakes the Tika Pila monster and he shouts the biggest shout ever, scaring Tiggy and making the pie fly up high and splatter down on his face! The inevitable terrible has happened and there is nothing to give the Mayor. Just then when things couldn’t get any worse Mayor De Pfeffel lunges inside and is happy to see a whole plate of his favourite custard sandwiches.

programme.title: Healthy Habits: Eating, Cleaning & Staying Tidy

programme.title: Whirlwind
programme.desc: Deedee is sadly whirling the magic wand wondering what to do. But no matter what Nino suggests, Deedee wants to have the magical version of it all, be it baking a cake or even walking. Finally they decide on the giant jumble jigsaw. Inspite of Nino’s efforts to have a non-magic activity, Deedee’s magic seems to be only solution to tackling the over-sized pieces. But the spell literally whips up a storm. Deedee struggles to control the whirlwind, but it whizzes past out of control into the field ahead. The jigsaw pieces fall in place perfectly but the whirlwind hasn’t stopped. The whirlwind becomes so naughty that it snatches Deedee’s magic wand away. The whirlwind wildly knocks down everything in its path and throws out all the things inside Tiggy’s house. Not to mention the letters of postman Charlie. Even though all are shaken up pretty much by the naughty whirlwind, Deedee is encouraged by all her friends to catch it. The whirlwind even plays mischief with the Tika Pila monster and also the Mayor! The Mayor falls with a bump out of the whirlwind, but luckily with Deedee’s wand. They decide to wear-out the whirlwind safely without magic. They come up with a plan and together do their thing. The whirlwind gradually gets tired and so does the magic wear off. Although it messed up the town, all of them have quite a laugh.

programme.title: Whirlwind
programme.desc: Deedee is sadly whirling the magic wand wondering what to do. But no matter what Nino suggests, Deedee wants to have the magical version of it all, be it baking a cake or even walking. Finally they decide on the giant jumble jigsaw. Inspite of Nino’s efforts to have a non-magic activity, Deedee’s magic seems to be only solution to tackling the over-sized pieces. But the spell literally whips up a storm. Deedee struggles to control the whirlwind, but it whizzes past out of control into the field ahead. The jigsaw pieces fall in place perfectly but the whirlwind hasn’t stopped. The whirlwind becomes so naughty that it snatches Deedee’s magic wand away. The whirlwind wildly knocks down everything in its path and throws out all the things inside Tiggy’s house. Not to mention the letters of postman Charlie. Even though all are shaken up pretty much by the naughty whirlwind, Deedee is encouraged by all her friends to catch it. The whirlwind even plays mischief with the Tika Pila monster and also the Mayor! The Mayor falls with a bump out of the whirlwind, but luckily with Deedee’s wand. They decide to wear-out the whirlwind safely without magic. They come up with a plan and together do their thing. The whirlwind gradually gets tired and so does the magic wear off. Although it messed up the town, all of them have quite a laugh.

programme.title: Bubble Cars
programme.desc: As Deedee and Nino were wondering what Charlie got the twins for their birthday, Sandy whizzes past in a brand new pedal car. Boris got one too, but he doesn’t want his to get dirty at all. So he decides not to use it at all even though he misses all the fun Sandy is having. Mewmew and Sandy even have a race across town. Boris even declines a chance to race, but is entirely sceptical about it as he doesn’t even want a splash of mud to fall on it. He is even more worried when he sees Sandy’s car not working. Deedee tries to help by magically trying to create a bubble guard around Boris’s car, but the spell falls on Sandy’s car instead. Now no one can even touch the car, let alone repair it. Boris vouches to allow Sandy use his car as he acknowledges that it was his undoing that led to the creation of the bubble in the first place. Sandy is overjoyed and promises to be extra careful. So careful that Mewmew can even beat her by running on his ears. Deedee tells Boris to prove to Sandy that she can use the car faster, so Boris races with Mewmew and accidentally splashes mud over his face, but then is happy he does and enjoys the fun. He races so fast that he pops the bubble guard over Sandy’s car by crashing into it. Charlie sets down to fix the cars and the twins are driving them in a jiffy, giggling all the way.

programme.title: Bubble Cars
programme.desc: As Deedee and Nino were wondering what Charlie got the twins for their birthday, Sandy whizzes past in a brand new pedal car. Boris got one too, but he doesn’t want his to get dirty at all. So he decides not to use it at all even though he misses all the fun Sandy is having. Mewmew and Sandy even have a race across town. Boris even declines a chance to race, but is entirely sceptical about it as he doesn’t even want a splash of mud to fall on it. He is even more worried when he sees Sandy’s car not working. Deedee tries to help by magically trying to create a bubble guard around Boris’s car, but the spell falls on Sandy’s car instead. Now no one can even touch the car, let alone repair it. Boris vouches to allow Sandy use his car as he acknowledges that it was his undoing that led to the creation of the bubble in the first place. Sandy is overjoyed and promises to be extra careful. So careful that Mewmew can even beat her by running on his ears. Deedee tells Boris to prove to Sandy that she can use the car faster, so Boris races with Mewmew and accidentally splashes mud over his face, but then is happy he does and enjoys the fun. He races so fast that he pops the bubble guard over Sandy’s car by crashing into it. Charlie sets down to fix the cars and the twins are driving them in a jiffy, giggling all the way.
